title: Harness self-check: world -> menu -> world through synthetic physical input
_comment: NOT a protocol segment. This is the acceptance evidence for ralph/GATE_F_INSTRUMENTATION_REQUEST.md item 1: the harness boots the real scene, opens the pause shell with a real physical event, moves focus with parse_input_event, and closes it, with events.jsonl showing input_context transitioning world -> menu -> world and the focus fields populated. The real S01-S10 / X01-X08 files are transcribed separately from protocol section E.

steps.title: boot the real Meadows
steps.expected: the real world scene stands up with the real autoloads and the player has control

steps.title: the world owns input at rest
steps.expected: nothing owns input, no fight is running, no ghost is armed: input_context is 'world'

steps.title: settle before pressing anything
steps.expected: a few frames of quiet so the opening's own sequencing is not mid-fade

steps.title: open the pause shell with the bound button
steps.expected: the game_menu action, sent as a real physical event, opens the pause shell

steps.title: the shell owns input
steps.expected: input_context is a menu context; the tree is paused and the shell holds the input-owner group

steps.title: something holds GUI focus
steps.expected: a Control holds focus. Without one the stick moves nothing and the menu is decoration on a handheld.

steps.title: the stick moves focus
steps.expected: ui_down, delivered as a physical event, moves focus to a different control

steps.title: close the shell
steps.expected: menu_cancel closes the shell and hands the world back

steps.title: the world owns input again
steps.expected: input_context is back to 'world': the tree is unpaused and nothing holds the input-owner group

steps.title: capture the closed state

args.intended_proof: the HUD is back after the shell closed; file:null under a headless run is the expected logic-mode result

steps.expected: a PNG in capture mode, a manifest row with file:null and a reason in logic mode
